decisions.reason: As a software platform for building GIS solutions, D is highly related to the firm's core geospatial integration capabilities and, with the firm's own R&D and standards-oriented knowledge base, management is likely to see good scope to improve and commercialize it rather than withdraw it.

E fits closely with the firm's established GIS and mobile application expertise, so its strong relatedness and the firm's in-house R&D make continued learning and adaptation feasible, although competition and portfolio focus create some risk.

F is a close-to-core web map search extension and the 2019 version update suggests active post-launch development, so absorptive capacity argues for retaining it, though the firm's earlier pruning of smaller plugins makes it somewhat more droppable than the larger core offers.
